{"operationName":"HomeFeed","variables":{"sectionsStartingFrom":2,"sectionsToLoad":-1,"preview":false},"query":"query HomeFeed($preview: Boolean, $sectionsStartingFrom: Int = 0, $sectionsToLoad: Int = -1) {
  homepageFeed(
    preview: $preview
    sectionsStartingFrom: $sectionsStartingFrom
    sectionsToLoad: $sectionsToLoad
  ) {
    ...feedModuleFragment
    __typename
  }
}

fragment feedModuleFragment on FeedModuleData {
  id
  basicModuleData {
    headline
    type
    subhead
    image
    linkText
    linkPath
    termsText
    termsEditorialContent
    __typename
  }
  keyProduct {
    ...productTileFragment
    __typename
  }
  featuredProducts {
    ...productTileFragment
    __typename
  }
  youtubeVideoId
  modules {
    headline
    subhead
    image
    linkText
    linkPath
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment productTileFragment on ProductBasicData {
  productId
  productPageUrl
  categoryId
  skuCode
  productName
  productDescription
  brandName
  unitSize
  deal
  unitPrice
  weightDisclaimer
  estimatedWeightDisclaimer
  discountAmount {
    ...priceFragment
    __typename
  }
  salesUnits {
    ...salesUnitFragment
    __typename
  }
  price {
    ...priceFragment
    __typename
  }
  formattedCurrentPrice
  roughPricePerUnit
  defaultScaleUnit
  pricePerScaleUnit
  scaleUnit
  servingSize
  productZoomImage
  productJumboImage
  productAlternateImage
  marketingTags {
    soldOut
    sponsored
    yourFave
    backOnline
    new
    __typename
  }
  featureTags {
    topPick
    freeSample
    expressEligible
    __typename
  }
  groupScale {
    grpId
    version
    grpPrice
    grpDescription
    __typename
  }
  coupon {
    ...couponFragment
    __typename
  }
  wasPrice {
    ...priceFragment
    __typename
  }
  quantity {
    ...productQuantityFragment
    __typename
  }
  availability
  available
  alcoholic
  preparationTime
  savingString
  availMaterialPrices {
    price
    pricingUnit
    scaleLowerBound
    scaleUpperBound
    scaleUnit
    promoPrice
    __typename
  }
  cvPrices {
    charName
    charValueName
    price
    pricingUnit
    applyHow
    salesOrg
    distChannel
    __typename
  }
  grpPrices {
    price
    pricingUnit
    scaleLowerBound
    scaleUpperBound
    scaleUnit
    promoPrice
    __typename
  }
  variantId
  variations {
    name
    label
    optional
    display
    underLabel
    descrPopup
    descrMedia
    values {
      name
      label
      isLabelValue
      selected
      cvp
      imagePath
      productName
      description
      variationItemProductData {
        categoryId
        productId
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  externalData {
    ...productExternalDataFragment
    __typename
  }
  fdWinesAndSpirits
  soldBySalesUnit
  bundle {
    ...productMealBundleFragment
    __typename
  }
  configuration {
    key
    value
    __typename
  }
  clickBeacon
  imageBeacon
  viewBeacon
  recommendedProduct {
    productId
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment priceFragment on Price {
  currency
  value
  formattedPrice
  properties {
    type
    value
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment salesUnitFragment on SalesUnit {
  alternateSalesUnit
  name
  selected
  salesUnit
  ratio
  __typename
}

fragment couponFragment on Coupon {
  couponId
  version
  displayDescription
  detailedDescription
  value
  quantity
  expirationDate
  offerType {
    name
    description
    __typename
  }
  status {
    name
    description
    displayMessage
    __typename
  }
  displayStatus {
    name
    description
    __typename
  }
  couponProductInfo {
    catId
    productId
    skuCode
    upc
    __typename
  }
  displayStatusMessage
  context {
    name
    description
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment productQuantityFragment on ProductQuantity {
  quantity
  minQuantity
  maxQuantity
  quantityIncrement
  __typename
}

fragment productExternalDataFragment on ProductExternalData {
  externalWidgetId
  externalWidgetType
  externalResponseId
  __typename
}

fragment productMealBundleFragment on Bundle {
  type
  variationGroups {
    name
    label
    variations {
      name
      label
      optional
      display
      underLabel
      descrPopup
      descrMedia
      marinadeData {
        title
        __typename
      }
      values {
        name
        label
        isLabelValue
        selected
        cvp
        productName
        description
        imagePath
        variationItemProductData {
          categoryId
          productId
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}"}

[{"operationName":"AlternativeProduct","variables":{"productId":"hmr_veg_grlckale","skipHealthWarning":true},"query":"query AlternativeProduct($productId: ID!, $skipHealthWarning: Boolean) {
  product(productId: $productId, skipHealthWarning: $skipHealthWarning) {
    productBasicData {
      ...productBasicFragment
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}

fragment productBasicFragment on ProductBasicData {
  listItemLineId
  productId
  productPageUrl
  categoryId
  deal
  categoryPageUrl
  skuCode
  productName
  akaName
  brandName
  packCount
  unitSize
  unitPrice
  weightDisclaimer
  estimatedWeightDisclaimer
  salesUnits {
    ...salesUnitFragment
    __typename
  }
  price {
    ...priceFragment
    __typename
  }
  formattedCurrentPrice
  roughPricePerUnit
  defaultScaleUnit
  pricePerScaleUnit
  scaleUnit
  servingSize
  productImage
  productDetailImage
  productZoomImage
  productJumboImage
  productAlternateImage
  productImagePackage
  productDescription
  productQualityNote
  marketingTags {
    soldOut
    sponsored
    yourFave
    backOnline
    new
    __typename
  }
  featureTags {
    topPick
    freeSample
    expressEligible
    __typename
  }
  groupScale {
    grpId
    version
    grpPrice
    grpDescription
    __typename
  }
  coupon {
    ...couponFragment
    __typename
  }
  wasPrice {
    ...priceFragment
    __typename
  }
  quantity {
    ...productQuantityFragment
    __typename
  }
  availability
  available
  alcoholic
  preparationTime
  scalePrice {
    price {
      ...priceFragment
      __typename
    }
    promoPrice {
      ...priceFragment
      __typename
    }
    scaleUnit
    pricingUnit
    scaleLowerBound
    scaleUpperBound
    __typename
  }
  savingString
  availMaterialPrices {
    price
    pricingUnit
    scaleLowerBound
    scaleUpperBound
    scaleUnit
    promoPrice
    __typename
  }
  cvPrices {
    charName
    charValueName
    price
    pricingUnit
    applyHow
    salesOrg
    distChannel
    __typename
  }
  grpPrices {
    price
    pricingUnit
    scaleLowerBound
    scaleUpperBound
    scaleUnit
    promoPrice
    __typename
  }
  variantId
  variations {
    name
    label
    optional
    display
    underLabel
    descrPopup
    descrMedia
    values {
      name
      label
      isLabelValue
      selected
      cvp
      imagePath
      productName
      description
      variationItemProductData {
        categoryId
        productId
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  fdWinesAndSpirits
  soldBySalesUnit
  bundle {
    ...productMealBundleFragment
    __typename
  }
  configuration {
    key
    value
    __typename
  }
  discountAmount {
    ...priceFragment
    __typename
  }
  clickBeacon
  imageBeacon
  viewBeacon
  recommendedProduct {
    productId
    __typename
  }
  discontinuedSoon
  __typename
}

fragment priceFragment on Price {
  currency
  value
  formattedPrice
  properties {
    type
    value
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment salesUnitFragment on SalesUnit {
  alternateSalesUnit
  name
  selected
  salesUnit
  ratio
  __typename
}

fragment couponFragment on Coupon {
  couponId
  version
  displayDescription
  detailedDescription
  value
  quantity
  expirationDate
  offerType {
    name
    description
    __typename
  }
  status {
    name
    description
    displayMessage
    __typename
  }
  displayStatus {
    name
    description
    __typename
  }
  couponProductInfo {
    catId
    productId
    skuCode
    upc
    __typename
  }
  displayStatusMessage
  context {
    name
    description
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment productQuantityFragment on ProductQuantity {
  quantity
  minQuantity
  maxQuantity
  quantityIncrement
  __typename
}

fragment productMealBundleFragment on Bundle {
  type
  variationGroups {
    name
    label
    variations {
      name
      label
      optional
      display
      underLabel
      descrPopup
      descrMedia
      marinadeData {
        title
        __typename
      }
      values {
        name
        label
        isLabelValue
        selected
        cvp
        productName
        description
        imagePath
        variationItemProductData {
          categoryId
          productId
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}"}]

[{"operationName":"DeliveryPassPlans","variables":{},"query":"query DeliveryPassPlans {
  deliveryPasses {
    freeTrialEligible
    freeTrialOptinSku
    displayOverlay
    deliveryPasses {
      isActive
      isPreviousPlan
      isBestValue
      descriptionMediaPath
      deliveryPassProduct {
        ...productBasicFragment
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}

fragment productBasicFragment on ProductBasicData {
  listItemLineId
  productId
  productPageUrl
  categoryId
  deal
  categoryPageUrl
  skuCode
  productName
  akaName
  brandName
  packCount
  unitSize
  unitPrice
  weightDisclaimer
  estimatedWeightDisclaimer
  salesUnits {
    ...salesUnitFragment
    __typename
  }
  price {
    ...priceFragment
    __typename
  }
  formattedCurrentPrice
  roughPricePerUnit
  defaultScaleUnit
  pricePerScaleUnit
  scaleUnit
  servingSize
  productImage
  productDetailImage
  productZoomImage
  productJumboImage
  productAlternateImage
  productImagePackage
  productDescription
  productQualityNote
  marketingTags {
    soldOut
    sponsored
    yourFave
    backOnline
    new
    __typename
  }
  featureTags {
    topPick
    freeSample
    expressEligible
    __typename
  }
  groupScale {
    grpId
    version
    grpPrice
    grpDescription
    __typename
  }
  coupon {
    ...couponFragment
    __typename
  }
  wasPrice {
    ...priceFragment
    __typename
  }
  quantity {
    ...productQuantityFragment
    __typename
  }
  availability
  available
  alcoholic
  preparationTime
  scalePrice {
    price {
      ...priceFragment
      __typename
    }
    promoPrice {
      ...priceFragment
      __typename
    }
    scaleUnit
    pricingUnit
    scaleLowerBound
    scaleUpperBound
    __typename
  }
  savingString
  availMaterialPrices {
    price
    pricingUnit
    scaleLowerBound
    scaleUpperBound
    scaleUnit
    promoPrice
    __typename
  }
  cvPrices {
    charName
    charValueName
    price
    pricingUnit
    applyHow
    salesOrg
    distChannel
    __typename
  }
  grpPrices {
    price
    pricingUnit
    scaleLowerBound
    scaleUpperBound
    scaleUnit
    promoPrice
    __typename
  }
  variantId
  variations {
    name
    label
    optional
    display
    underLabel
    descrPopup
    descrMedia
    values {
      name
      label
      isLabelValue
      selected
      cvp
      imagePath
      productName
      description
      variationItemProductData {
        categoryId
        productId
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  fdWinesAndSpirits
  soldBySalesUnit
  bundle {
    ...productMealBundleFragment
    __typename
  }
  configuration {
    key
    value
    __typename
  }
  discountAmount {
    ...priceFragment
    __typename
  }
  clickBeacon
  imageBeacon
  viewBeacon
  recommendedProduct {
    productId
    __typename
  }
  discontinuedSoon
  __typename
}

fragment priceFragment on Price {
  currency
  value
  formattedPrice
  properties {
    type
    value
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment salesUnitFragment on SalesUnit {
  alternateSalesUnit
  name
  selected
  salesUnit
  ratio
  __typename
}

fragment couponFragment on Coupon {
  couponId
  version
  displayDescription
  detailedDescription
  value
  quantity
  expirationDate
  offerType {
    name
    description
    __typename
  }
  status {
    name
    description
    displayMessage
    __typename
  }
  displayStatus {
    name
    description
    __typename
  }
  couponProductInfo {
    catId
    productId
    skuCode
    upc
    __typename
  }
  displayStatusMessage
  context {
    name
    description
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment productQuantityFragment on ProductQuantity {
  quantity
  minQuantity
  maxQuantity
  quantityIncrement
  __typename
}

fragment productMealBundleFragment on Bundle {
  type
  variationGroups {
    name
    label
    variations {
      name
      label
      optional
      display
      underLabel
      descrPopup
      descrMedia
      marinadeData {
        title
        __typename
      }
      values {
        name
        label
        isLabelValue
        selected
        cvp
        productName
        description
        imagePath
        variationItemProductData {
          categoryId
          productId
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}"}]

fragment feedModuleFragment on FeedModuleData {

    __typename
  }
  youtubeVideoId

    headline
    subhead
    image
    linkText
    linkPath
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment productTileFragment on ProductBasicData {
  productId

  skuCode
  productName
  productDescription
  brandName
  unitSize
  deal
  unitPrice
  weightDisclaimer
  estimatedWeightDisclaimer
  discountAmount {

    __typename
  }

    ...salesUnitFragment
    __typename
  }
  price {
    ...priceFragment
    __typename
  }
  formattedCurrentPrice
  roughPricePerUnit

  servingSize
  productZoomImage

  productAlternateImage
  marketingTags {

  featureTags {
    topPick

    __typename

    grpId

    grpPrice
    grpDescription
    __typename
  }

  }

  }
  quantity {
    ...productQuantityFragment
    __typename
  }
  availability
  available
  alcoholic
  preparationTime
  savingString
  availMaterialPrices {
    price
    pricingUnit
    scaleLowerBound
    scaleUpperBound
    scaleUnit
    promoPrice
    __typename
  }
  cvPrices {
    charName
    charValueName
    price
    pricingUnit
    applyHow
    salesOrg
    distChannel
    __typename
  }
  grpPrices {
    price
    pricingUnit
    scaleLowerBound
    scaleUpperBound
    scaleUnit
    promoPrice
    __typename
  }
  variantId
  variations {
    name
    label

      cvp
      imagePath
      productName
      description
      variationItemProductData {
        categoryId
        productId
        __typename
      }
      __typename

    __typename
  }

    ...productExternalDataFragment
    __typename
  }
  fdWinesAndSpirits
  soldBySalesUnit

    ...productMealBundleFragment
    __typename
  }

    key
    value
    __typename

  viewBeacon

    productId
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment priceFragment on Price {
  currency
  value
  formattedPrice

    __typename

          categoryId

    __typename

{"operationName":"ReorderFeed","variables":{},"query":"query ReorderFeed {
  reorderFeed {
    ...feedModuleFragment
    __typename
  }
}

fragment feedModuleFragment on FeedModuleData {
  id
  basicModuleData {
    headline
    type
    subhead
    image
    linkText
    linkPath
    termsText
    termsEditorialContent
    __typename
  }
  keyProduct {
    ...productTileFragment
    __typename
  }
  featuredProducts {
    ...productTileFragment
    __typename
  }
  youtubeVideoId
  modules {
    headline
    subhead
    image
    linkText
    linkPath
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment productTileFragment on ProductBasicData {
  productId
  productPageUrl
  categoryId
  skuCode
  productName
  productDescription
  brandName
  unitSize
  deal
  unitPrice
  weightDisclaimer
  estimatedWeightDisclaimer
  discountAmount {
    ...priceFragment
    __typename
  }
  salesUnits {
    ...salesUnitFragment
    __typename
  }
  price {
    ...priceFragment
    __typename
  }
  formattedCurrentPrice
  roughPricePerUnit
  defaultScaleUnit
  pricePerScaleUnit
  scaleUnit
  servingSize
  productZoomImage
  productJumboImage
  productAlternateImage
  marketingTags {
    soldOut
    sponsored
    yourFave
    backOnline
    new
    __typename
  }
  featureTags {
    topPick
    freeSample
    expressEligible
    __typename
  }
  groupScale {
    grpId
    version
    grpPrice
    grpDescription
    __typename
  }
  coupon {
    ...couponFragment
    __typename
  }
  wasPrice {
    ...priceFragment
    __typename
  }
  quantity {
    ...productQuantityFragment
    __typename
  }
  availability
  available
  alcoholic
  preparationTime
  savingString
  availMaterialPrices {
    price
    pricingUnit
    scaleLowerBound
    scaleUpperBound
    scaleUnit
    promoPrice
    __typename
  }
  cvPrices {
    charName
    charValueName
    price
    pricingUnit
    applyHow
    salesOrg
    distChannel
    __typename
  }
  grpPrices {
    price
    pricingUnit
    scaleLowerBound
    scaleUpperBound
    scaleUnit
    promoPrice
    __typename
  }
  variantId
  variations {
    name
    label
    optional
    display
    underLabel
    descrPopup
    descrMedia
    values {
      name
      label
      isLabelValue
      selected
      cvp
      imagePath
      productName
      description
      variationItemProductData {
        categoryId
        productId
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  externalData {
    ...productExternalDataFragment
    __typename
  }
  fdWinesAndSpirits
  soldBySalesUnit
  bundle {
    ...productMealBundleFragment
    __typename
  }
  configuration {
    key
    value
    __typename
  }
  clickBeacon
  imageBeacon
  viewBeacon
  recommendedProduct {
    productId
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment priceFragment on Price {
  currency
  value
  formattedPrice
  properties {
    type
    value
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment salesUnitFragment on SalesUnit {
  alternateSalesUnit
  name
  selected
  salesUnit
  ratio
  __typename
}

fragment couponFragment on Coupon {
  couponId
  version
  displayDescription
  detailedDescription
  value
  quantity
  expirationDate
  offerType {
    name
    description
    __typename
  }
  status {
    name
    description
    displayMessage
    __typename
  }
  displayStatus {
    name
    description
    __typename
  }
  couponProductInfo {
    catId
    productId
    skuCode
    upc
    __typename
  }
  displayStatusMessage
  context {
    name
    description
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment productQuantityFragment on ProductQuantity {
  quantity
  minQuantity
  maxQuantity
  quantityIncrement
  __typename
}

fragment productExternalDataFragment on ProductExternalData {
  externalWidgetId
  externalWidgetType
  externalResponseId
  __typename
}

fragment productMealBundleFragment on Bundle {
  type
  variationGroups {
    name
    label
    variations {
      name
      label
      optional
      display
      underLabel
      descrPopup
      descrMedia
      marinadeData {
        title
        __typename
      }
      values {
        name
        label
        isLabelValue
        selected
        cvp
        productName
        description
        imagePath
        variationItemProductData {
          categoryId
          productId
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}"}

[{"operationName":"DeliveryPassPlans","variables":{},"query":"query DeliveryPassPlans {
  deliveryPasses {
    freeTrialEligible

      isActive
      isPreviousPlan
      isBestValue
      descriptionMediaPath
      deliveryPassProduct {
        ...productBasicFragment
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}

fragment productBasicFragment on ProductBasicData {
  listItemLineId
  productId
  productPageUrl
  categoryId
  deal
  categoryPageUrl
  skuCode
  productName
  akaName
  brandName
  packCount
  unitSize
  unitPrice
  weightDisclaimer
  estimatedWeightDisclaimer
  salesUnits {
    ...salesUnitFragment
    __typename
  }
  price {
    ...priceFragment
    __typename
  }
  formattedCurrentPrice
  roughPricePerUnit
  defaultScaleUnit
  pricePerScaleUnit
  scaleUnit
  servingSize
  productImage
  productDetailImage
  productZoomImage
  productJumboImage
  productAlternateImage
  productImagePackage
  productDescription
  productQualityNote
  marketingTags {
    soldOut
    sponsored
    yourFave
    backOnline
    new
    __typename
  }
  featureTags {
    topPick
    freeSample
    expressEligible
    __typename
  }
  groupScale {
    grpId
    version
    grpPrice
    grpDescription
    __typename
  }
  coupon {
    ...couponFragment
    __typename
  }
  wasPrice {
    ...priceFragment
    __typename
  }
  quantity {
    ...productQuantityFragment
    __typename
  }
  availability
  available
  alcoholic
  preparationTime
  scalePrice {
    price {
      ...priceFragment
      __typename
    }
    promoPrice {
      ...priceFragment
      __typename
    }
    scaleUnit
    pricingUnit
    scaleLowerBound
    scaleUpperBound
    __typename
  }
  savingString
  availMaterialPrices {
    price
    pricingUnit
    scaleLowerBound
    scaleUpperBound
    scaleUnit
    promoPrice
    __typename
  }
  cvPrices {
    charName
    charValueName
    price
    pricingUnit
    applyHow
    salesOrg
    distChannel
    __typename
  }
  grpPrices {
    price
    pricingUnit
    scaleLowerBound
    scaleUpperBound
    scaleUnit
    promoPrice
    __typename
  }
  variantId
  variations {
    name
    label
    optional
    display
    underLabel
    descrPopup
    descrMedia
    values {
      name
      label
      isLabelValue
      selected
      cvp
      imagePath
      productName
      description
      variationItemProductData {
        categoryId
        productId
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  fdWinesAndSpirits
  soldBySalesUnit
  bundle {
    ...productMealBundleFragment
    __typename
  }
  configuration {
    key
    value
    __typename
  }
  discountAmount {
    ...priceFragment
    __typename
  }
  clickBeacon
  imageBeacon
  viewBeacon
  recommendedProduct {
    productId
    __typename
  }
  discontinuedSoon
  __typename
}

fragment priceFragment on Price {
  currency
  value
  formattedPrice
  properties {
    type
    value
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment salesUnitFragment on SalesUnit {
  alternateSalesUnit
  name
  selected
  salesUnit
  ratio
  __typename
}

fragment couponFragment on Coupon {
  couponId
  version
  displayDescription
  detailedDescription
  value
  quantity
  expirationDate
  offerType {
    name
    description
    __typename
  }
  status {
    name
    description
    displayMessage
    __typename
  }
  displayStatus {
    name
    description
    __typename
  }
  couponProductInfo {
    catId
    productId
    skuCode
    upc
    __typename
  }
  displayStatusMessage
  context {
    name
    description
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment productQuantityFragment on ProductQuantity {
  quantity
  minQuantity
  maxQuantity
  quantityIncrement
  __typename
}

fragment productMealBundleFragment on Bundle {
  type
  variationGroups {
    name
    label
    variations {
      name
      label
      optional
      display
      underLabel
      descrPopup
      descrMedia
      marinadeData {
        title
        __typename
      }
      values {
        name
        label
        isLabelValue
        selected
        cvp
        productName
        description
        imagePath
        variationItemProductData {
          categoryId
          productId
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}"}]
